visual_review.findings: Original and Repeat destination controls are visible and independent; copy-original no longer overlaps cost review. Unmoved enemy rejected, moved enemy selectable, repeated Move ends at field 2. Full card text and movement-history hover fit at 1152x720.

findings_resolved: Every repeated Move can choose an independent destination during finalization, with original and repeated targets checked against their own destination. This also fixes Charm and Ride the Wind.
Only actual Moves create physical-unit movement history. Group moves, forced moves and successful halves of swaps count; entry, recall, prevented and same-location moves do not create history.
Hunker Down leaves an earlier Move fact intact while preventing a later Siren Move. Recall preserves prior history. Changing control preserves history; leaving and replaying creates a new object.
The native cost-review button no longer covers Copy original choices in the movement panel; both controls are exercised through actual clicks.
Native hover-capture helper now supports either owner. The first expanded smoke attempt exposed its player-0-only assumption; final release runs pass for an opposing moved unit.
Focused fixtures were corrected to finish their showdowns before testing open-main-phase actions and payment refusal. Both Irelia and Navori Scout pay their printed Deflect.
limitations: One card-pool addition, not a new verified tournament preset or match-sideboarding feature.
